244: const scopedPlugin: PluginCreator<string> = (id = '') => {
245:   const keyframes = Object.create(null)
246:   const shortId = id.replace(/^data-v-/, '')
247:   const rewriter = new ScopedSelectorRewriter(id)
248: 
249:   return {
250:     postcssPlugin: 'vue-sfc-scoped',
251:     Rule(rule) {
252:       rewriter.rewriteSelector(rule)
253:     },
254:     AtRule(node) {
255:       if (
256:         /-?keyframes$/.test(node.name) &&
257:         !node.params.endsWith(`-${shortId}`)
258:       ) {
259:         // register keyframes
260:         keyframes[node.params] = node.params = node.params + '-' + shortId
261:       }
262:     },
263:     OnceExit(root) {
264:       if (Object.keys(keyframes).length) {
265:         // If keyframes are found in this <style>, find and rewrite animation names
266:         // in declarations.
267:         // Caveat: this only works for keyframes and animation rules in the same
268:         // <style> element.
269:         // individual animation-name declaration
270:         root.walkDecls(decl => {
271:           if (animationNameRE.test(decl.prop)) {
272:             decl.value = decl.value
273:               .split(',')
274:               .map(v => keyframes[v.trim()] || v.trim())
275:               .join(',')
276:           }
277:           // shorthand
278:           if (animationRE.test(decl.prop)) {
279:             decl.value = decl.value
280:               .split(',')
281:               .map(v => {
282:                 const vals = v.trim().split(/\s+/)
283:                 const i = vals.findIndex(val => keyframes[val])
284:                 if (i !== -1) {
285:                   vals.splice(i, 1, keyframes[vals[i]])
286:                   return vals.join(' ')
287:                 } else {
288:                   return v
289:                 }
290:               })
291:               .join(',')
292:           }
293:         })
294:       }
295:     },
296:   }
297: }
298: 
299: function isSpaceCombinator(node: selectorParser.Node) {
300:   return node.type === 'combinator' && /^\s+$/.test(node.value)
301: }
